=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 143-527 (deleted block) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker lifecycle functions were deleted while production callers still invoke them.
  WHY: Brokered phases fail with command not found before Codex starts, removing the credential-isolation boundary.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 665-671 (the `codex --sandbox danger-full-access` invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase runs issue-derived prompts through bare Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` instead of the brokered read-only path.
  WHY: The workflow environment contains GH_TOKEN/GH_PAT and OPENROUTER_API_KEY, allowing prompt-injected execution to access or exfiltrate credentials and mutate the workspace.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: lines 3038-3055 (`_inject_token_into_url`), lines 3074-3087 (`_resolve_origin_url`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using credential-free URLs with per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication.
  WHY: The PAT appears in process arguments, Git diagnostics, remote URL output, and related tooling.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 578-585 (`_memory_force_tick_remote_url`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick Git operations construct URLs containing the raw GH_PAT or GH_TOKEN.
  WHY: Subsequent `git ls-remote`, `git clone`, and `git push` receive the credential in argv and Git diagnostics.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: normalize_path at lines 240-247; emit_context at lines 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path-count limits were deleted, so caller-supplied paths are resolved and read without credential-file guards.
  WHY: Issue- or plan-derived paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, or `.aws` can be inlined into model prompts, including through resolved symlinks.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 255-261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `--provider-base-url` option was removed and generated configuration hard-codes `base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"`.
  WHY: Existing brokered callers fail with unknown argument, while callers that remove the flag bypass the loopback broker.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage (line 7), argument parser (lines 30-70) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `--process-group-file` option and associated process-group supervision were removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit with an unknown-option error before the editor starts, and cleanup loses process-group tracking.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: git_with_github_auth deleted (formerly lines 493-498); review_blocked_* family deleted (formerly lines 947-1352) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Authenticated push and review-blocked approval/successor helper APIs were deleted while live callers remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes and terminal review-blocked approval handling fail with missing-command errors.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: REST comment transform at lines 766-772, GraphQL comment query at lines 833-839 and transform at lines 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment payload transforms now emit only `{author, body, created_at}` and drop `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Producer authentication and trusted-approver authorization cannot distinguish valid review-blocked comments.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: module-level exports; formerly MAX_TARGET_PATHS = 256 (line 155), MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES = 1024 (line 156), is_sensitive_target_path (formerly line 158) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path` were deleted while tests still import and use them.
  WHY: `tests/test_targeted_file_context.py` fails during collection before its tests run.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context at lines 538-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file, binary, overflow, and other marker lines do not advance `used_bytes`, and the path-count cap is gone.
  WHY: Large untrusted path lists can produce output beyond the documented `max_bytes` model-context budget.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: memory_ensure_branch at lines 137-156 and 597-624 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was deleted and `memory_ensure_branch` now uses bare Git operations without per-command authentication.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, step-local `GIT_CONFIG_*` exports do not persist, so private-repository branch checks and pushes fail.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 101-237 (new staged-support restore block) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block is gated on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but `.github/workflows/implement.yml` does not create or export them.
  WHY: The protection is dead code, so support-ref copies can still overwrite branch-owned helper changes.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: line 204 (`git merge-file -p -L editor -L staged -L HEAD -- "${staged_support_path}" "${staged_support_base}" "${staged_support_head}"`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The three-way merge passes HEAD as the common ancestor instead of using the staged support baseline as the base.
  WHY: If wired, the merge can drop branch-side helper edits; one reviewer disputed this diagnosis, stating the argument order is correct.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: Fetch memory helper scripts step at lines 88-117 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Immutable-only helper staging removed the consumer-local fallback path.
  WHY: Consumer repositories with local helper copies can fail the PR-close workflow when the immutable checkout lacks a required helper; another reviewer judged this behavior required by the linked issue.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 62-67 (pre_assembled_static.txt cleanup) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup checks the index rather than HEAD, omits `--staged` from restore, and removes the untracked-file cleanup fallback.
  WHY: Newly staged or modified `pre_assembled_static.txt` can remain staged or cause restore failure and then be committed.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 287-330 (signal forwarding), lines 331-351 (kill path), lines 435-462 (finally block) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-user tracking, survivor verification, and privileged descendant cleanup were removed.
  WHY: Surviving editor descendants can outlive the sudo parent and remain orphaned; missing Python also allows isolated launches to proceed without a stall killer.
- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: entire new staged-support rejection block, lines 1-76 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support rejection handler is unreachable because its upstream restore gate is never activated.
  WHY: Its human-label, latch, comment, and Telegram-alert behavior cannot execute when staged-support failures occur.
